Lara (PM): Quick sync — we need to land the long‑horizon routing roadmap for multi-region / multi-tenant isolation. Customers keep asking for tenant-level failover + predictable costs. Proposing a gating checklist and rollout phasing. Thoughts?

Deepak (Infra): +1. key constraints: cross-region bandwidth, per-tenant affinity, and ability to quarantine noisy tenants. need swimlanes for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Sasha (Eng-ML): Agree. Also: model-aware routing — different model variants per latency vs cost. We should include quality regression gates tied to eval sets.

Kevin (SRE): Suggested gating: (1) end-to-end canary for 10% traffic, (2) automated traffic spillback on SLO breach, (3) telemetry for token-level cost. If we have those, SLA risk low.

Priya (AE): From customers: they want explicit migration windows and rollback policies in contract. Also legal needs data residency guarantees for Private deploys.

Lara (PM): Draft gating checklist idea:
```
- Policy blueprint approved (tenancy, quarantine, fallback order)
- Canaries in 2 regions + automated rollback
- Cost budget guardrails per tenant
- Eval suites for model variant correctness
- Sales-facing migration playbook
```
Can we add missing items?

Deepak (Infra): Add: capacity planning test (0.5–2x spike) and inter-region failover bandwidth test. Also must define tenant metadata used for routing (labels, entitlements).

Sasha (Eng-ML): Add a quality threshold: no more than 2% regression on targeted prompts vs baseline. And a fallback model mapping table for quantized vs full precision variants.

Kevin (SRE): Ops checklist items: runbook for soft-eviction, metrics dash with per-tenant tail latency, alerting thresholds, and a feature-flag rollout path.

Priya (AE): Suggest Delivery SLAs: define migration SLAs (max N minutes of degraded perf), and clearly call out which customers require Private vs Dedicated. This affects pricing conversations.

Lara (PM): Timeline proposal: Q2 — policy & infra prototypes; Q3 — canary launch (select customers); Q4 — general availability. We can compress if we get 2 strategic customers to co-sponsor.

Deepak (Infra): Risk notes: upstream network limits could force narrower rollout. Need a preflight that emulates 3 large tenants.

Sasha (Eng-ML): Implementation note: model-aware routing requires model labels in the catalog + runtime matchers. We can reuse existing routing DSL but need a small extension for quality budgets.

Kevin (SRE): Ops automation tasks owned by SRE: spillback automation, per-tenant eviction, and SLA reporting. ETA? 6 weeks for MVP automation.

Lara (PM): Action items:
- Deepak: draft preflight tests + capacity matrix (due in 1wk)
- Sasha: propose eval acceptance criteria + fallback mapping (due 1.5w)
- Kevin: prototype spillback automation + dashboard mock (due 2w)
- Priya: customer migration checklist & contract language draft (due 2w)

Priya (AE): I'll start with language for Dedicated vs Private and highlight migration windows. putting in calendar with legal.

orch-deploy-bot: Deployment queued: infra/migrations/preflight-tests @deepak — job 9832 started :rocket:

Lara (PM): Great — let's reconvene next Tue. If anyone wants to push timeline, speak now or bring sponsor customers.

Kevin (SRE): :thumbsup:

Sasha (Eng-ML): small ask — include a slot for offline evals vs streaming prompts in the acceptance test.

Deepak (Infra): noted.

Lara (PM): Thanks all — leaving thread open for asynchronous updates. I'll post the first draft checklist later today. :seedling:
